messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "immediately"
set: ["immediately", "immediately call emergency services at 911", "tell healthcare provider immediately if given by injection", "administered immediately prior to or following anesthesia induction", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "stop using and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal", "get emergency medical help immediately if you have wheezing", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "IV dose should be given immediately before induction of anesthesia", "get medical help immediately if vision drops suddenly or eye hurts", "stop taking and call healthcare provider immediately for severe stomach pain", "stop taking and call healthcare professional immediately if symptoms of lactic acidosis", "do not stop suddenly", "take as soon as possible", "use as soon as possible"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
